_comment: Single source of truth for buyer testimonials on CongoAfricanGreys.com. Names and locations come from the breeder ONLY (Mark & Teri Benjamin ruled 2026-09-09); never infer a name from a photo filename or a sibling page. q1-q3 quotes are verbatim from the live homepage; q4 is Archie O'Brien's real review, verbatim from the breeder. `remap` lists the historical mis-attributions scripts/sweep_review_attribution.py rewrites: match on (name, quote prefix) -> replace with the target review. Gate: tests/test_review_attribution.py. Sweep: scripts/sweep_review_attribution.py --check. q15-q17 (Lawrence Brunner, Sandra Soliz, Ida Brim) were the pending trio; the breeder ruled 2026-09-11 (chat) that all three are real, wording identical to the /available/ hub. `pending` is now empty. "pending" holds reviews whose provenance is disputed: they are never rendered on /african-grey-reviews/, and the dist guard exempts them only from the verbatim check until the breeder rules; scripts/review_inventory.py --write replaces "pending" wholesale from its PENDING_SPECS.
